findings.message: rule "webFetch" names webFetch, the key a spec lists the tool under, but a rule is matched against the tool's name, WebFetch, so this rule never fires. Write "WebFetch".

rule "alwaysDeny Write(/etc/**)" never fires outside plan mode: "alwaysAllow Write", above it in the same list, matches every call it matches, and the first rule that matches a call decides it. Move it above "alwaysAllow Write".
